lines.zh: 变身之后，我的脚步更轻了。
lines.en: Since the change, my steps have grown lighter.

lines.zh: 我浮着走，风从两侧劈开。
lines.en: I walk on air; the wind splits on either side.

lines.zh: 身量长了一截，气也重了。
lines.en: My frame has grown and my aura with it.

lines.zh: 六颗星在胸前烧得发亮。
lines.en: The six stars burn bright on my chest.

lines.zh: 我踏过屋脊，瓦片被气掀开。
lines.en: I cross the rooftops and ki lifts the tiles.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，圈子收得很紧。
lines.en: I circle you, and the circle draws tight.

lines.zh: 脚下的尘土被卷成一道线。
lines.en: Dust beneath me rolls into a line.

lines.zh: 我落一步，地面陷下去一点。
lines.en: One step of mine sinks the ground a little.

lines.zh: 我往前滑，几乎不用费力。
lines.en: I slide forward with almost no effort.
My hem stretches into a line behind me.

lines.zh: 周围的空气跟着我一起动。
lines.en: The air moves along with me.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，压迫感却不小。
lines.en: I don't walk fast, and the pressure is heavy.

lines.zh: 我悬在那儿，气在四周烧。
lines.en: I hang there with ki burning around me.
My breathing is heavier than before.
The six stars brighten in turn.
I close my fingers and let them go.

lines.zh: 这一带的风都不敢靠近。
lines.en: Even the wind keeps its distance.

lines.zh: 气从肩头一阵阵冒出来。
lines.en: Ki rises off my shoulders in pulses.

lines.zh: 我仰起脸，让光落在眼上。
lines.en: I tip my face up and let the light hit my eyes.

lines.zh: 地面上的影子比之前宽。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground is wider now.

lines.zh: 我在试着习惯这副身体。
lines.en: I'm getting used to this body.

lines.zh: 衣角被气托起来，不落地。
lines.en: My hem rides the ki and never touches down.

lines.zh: 我停住不动，气还在往外扩。
lines.en: I stop moving and the aura keeps spreading.

lines.zh: 我压下气，免得烧了这片。
lines.en: I press the aura down so it won't burn this place.
My patience has grown shorter.

lines.zh: 这一口气吐出来，草都焦了。
lines.en: I breathe out and the grass scorches.

lines.zh: 你还没退，倒是有点意思。
lines.en: You haven't run — that's something.

lines.zh: 变身之后，我看你更小了。
lines.en: Since the change, you look even smaller.
I raise a hand and ki turns in my palm.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找我的破口。
lines.en: Your eyes are hunting for a gap in me.
There isn't one. Not a single one.
I come down and stand before you.

lines.zh: 你听见我喘气了吗，那是兴奋。
lines.en: Hear me breathing? That's excitement.
I smile and the aura swells.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我已经进了两步。
lines.en: You give half a step; I take two.
Stop looking; you won't find it.

lines.zh: 我给你一次机会，现在走。
lines.en: I'll give you one chance — leave now.
In this form, holding back isn't easy.
Your ki looks thin before me.
I raise a hand against the glare and watch you.
The soil under us packs hard.
I tilt my head as if appraising.
Your courage is spent in the wrong place.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，你就知道了。
lines.en: Stay a moment longer and you'll understand.
I give ground, yet my aura holds.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半边身体发麻。
lines.en: Half my body goes numb.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口带血的唾沫。
lines.en: I spit blood.
A corner of the six stars goes dark.
I brace on the ground and don't kneel.
A tear opens in my hem.
I look at the wound and smile.
My aura breaks up, then gathers again.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，很快就好了。
lines.en: My legs shake, then steady.
The pain only sharpens me.
None of that matters now.
I don't even want to look.

lines.zh: 这点诱惑，不够我抬手指。
lines.en: Not enough to lift a finger for.

lines.zh: 我的力量已经压过了饥饿。
lines.en: My power has outgrown hunger.
The wind scatters it.
What's in your hand is trembling.
I flick a finger and it flies away.

lines.zh: 要喂我，得拿出更大的东西。
lines.en: To feed me, bring something bigger.
I pull my aura in; not worth my time.
Don't offer that as a bargain.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，气先把你挡住。
lines.en: You charge and my aura stops you first.

lines.zh: 我一步都没退，脚下踩得很稳。
lines.en: I don't give an inch; my feet are planted.
You bounce off still spinning.

lines.zh: 这一撞让地面裂了一道。
lines.en: The impact cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬手一拨，把你推回原位。
lines.en: I swat a hand and put you back where you stood.
Your landing is loud.
I tilt my head and watch you get up.

lines.zh: 这点力道，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: I barely felt it.
The air squeezes out with a bang.

lines.zh: 我踏前一步，地面跟着沉。
lines.en: I step forward and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我们两个的气在天空对撞。
lines.en: Our two auras collide in the sky.

lines.zh: 她也变了，模样比先前更锋利。
lines.en: She's changed too, sharper than before.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段距离并行。
lines.en: We fly level, a ways apart.
The wind splits between us.
One of her stars burns dimmer than mine.
I don't close in, and neither does she.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了看，就这样。
lines.en: We look at each other, and that's all.

lines.zh: 气在中间撞出细小的火花。
lines.en: Small sparks burst where the auras meet.
For this moment, neither of us has lost.

lines.zh: 她转身飞走，我留在原地。
lines.en: She turns and flies off; I stay.

lines.zh: 我伸手，气先把它吸上来。
lines.en: I reach, and ki lifts it to me.
One turn between my fingers and it's powder.

lines.zh: 我拿起来看了看，随手丢了。
lines.en: I pick it up, look once, and drop it.

lines.zh: 这点分量，我现在感觉不到。
lines.en: At this strength I can't feel the weight.
My aura burns a corner off it.
It jumps in my hand as if alive.
I grip and hear it crack.
This is of no use to me now.
I toss it up and catch it again.

lines.zh: 变身之后，锁定只要一瞬。
lines.en: After the change, locking on takes an instant.
No more circling; I face it squarely.

lines.zh: 气把周围的影子都拉长了。
lines.en: My aura stretches every shadow around us.
I've known your position all along.
My leg lifts and the wind flattens beneath it.
No one is coming for you this time.
I've sealed this ground.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我眼里是一层纸。
lines.en: Your armor is paper to me.
I'm not counting to three anymore.
I mean to end it in one strike.
The soil is shuddering.

lines.zh: 我把肩往后拉，蓄了半息。
lines.en: I draw my shoulder back and hold half a breath.
One target — don't make me look.
Your guard comes up too late.
I put everything into this punch.

lines.zh: 我的气已经压到你脚边。
lines.en: My aura has reached your feet.
Wherever you retreat, my shadow follows.
I've closed this ring tight.
Ki layers over me, layer on layer.
Look up and you see only light.

lines.zh: 我一步步压近，地面在陷。
lines.en: Step by step I advance and the ground sinks.
Your movements look absurdly slow.
All six stars burn at their brightest.

lines.zh: 我在等你出手，好一次挡完。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to strike so I can end it.

lines.zh: 风被我的气推成一条直线。
lines.en: The wind straightens into a line behind me.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
This blow will go through you.
I raise a hand and light gathers at my fingers.
Every gap in your guard is showing.
I settle my weight onto my back leg.
One breath left — that's enough.
I push forward and the ki goes with me.
Don't close your eyes; watch.

lines.zh: 我踢出的脚带着气，砸穿了墙。
lines.en: My kick carries ki and punches through the wall.

lines.zh: 第一下是试探，后面全是实招。
lines.en: The first is a test; the rest land.
A ki wave leaves my palm.

lines.zh: 我贴身打，你连退都来不及。
lines.en: I fight close and you can't even retreat.

lines.zh: 连续三脚，你只挡住一脚。
lines.en: Three kicks; you block one.

lines.zh: 蓝风卷起来，把地上的东西全带起。
lines.en: Blue wind rises and lifts everything off the ground.
My fist lands and a patch of ground collapses.
This one comes from the side.
The shockwave lifts you off your feet.

lines.zh: 我的残影还留在你眼前。
lines.en: My afterimage lingers before your eyes.

lines.zh: 我转到你背后，只用了一步。
lines.en: I'm behind you in a single step.

lines.zh: 你挡的那一下，手骨裂了。
lines.en: The arm you blocked with cracks.
I pull the leg back and reset.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在你肩甲上，甲凹了。
lines.en: My fist hits your shoulder and the plate dents.
You're down and I keep pressing.
I have no intention of stopping.

lines.zh: 光炸开，我从里面走出来。
lines.en: The light bursts and I step out of it.
The change completes and ki pushes the clouds back.

lines.zh: 我的影子一下铺开很远。
lines.en: My shadow spreads a long way at once.

lines.zh: 六颗星在胸前烧成一片。
lines.en: The six stars burn together on my chest.

lines.zh: 风全停了，因为被我压住。
lines.en: The wind stops, held down by me.
I land and a ring of cracks spreads.
I look at my hand and close it.

lines.zh: 这一带的气被我挤得动了。
lines.en: The air here shifts under my pressure.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口，前面的树弯了。
lines.en: I breathe out and the trees ahead bend.

lines.zh: 我的衣摆被气冲得笔直。
lines.en: My hem snaps straight in the aura.
The clouds above are still scattering.
I open my eyes and light sits in them.
The soil under me bakes pale.
A dull boom rolls in from far off.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，看向前方。
lines.en: I raise my head and look ahead.

lines.zh: 这一形态，是我最后的样子。
lines.en: This form is my last.

lines.zh: 空气里全是烧过的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of scorching.
I take one step and the world makes way.

lines.zh: 火裹上来，被我的气顶开一半。
lines.en: Fire wraps me and my aura pushes half of it off.

lines.zh: 我直坠下来，砸出一个深坑。
lines.en: I fall straight down and leave a deep crater.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我的气也撑不住。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; even my aura fails.

lines.zh: 爆开的光把我掀得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over.

lines.zh: 一枚尖针穿透衣料扎进来。
lines.en: A sharp point pierces my clothes.

lines.zh: 咒光缠住我的脚踝，挣不开。
lines.en: Spell-light binds my ankle and won't yield.
Hunger has weakened my very aura.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，六颗星全烧红。
lines.en: Lightning hits and all six stars burn red.

lines.zh: 上下都没了，我落得很慢。
lines.en: Up and down are gone and I fall slowly.
